A door leads somewhere: entering it enters where it leads (its `into`), sets you down where it lands you (its `lands_at`), and may ask to hold something first (its `requires`). Those three are a door's alone, and a door is the town's to make and to change (Darko, 2026-11-25, CORE-129 layer 1). Moving it or withdrawing it stays its maker's.
